Management expects India Engineering to grow at mid- to-high teens and consolidated revenue by ~10–12% YoY in FY27, with long-term blended EBITDA margins of 20%+.
Bushings and stampings were the key growth drivers, with ~30% FY27 growth targeted across both segments and a longer-term revenue opportunity of ~INR3 bn each.
Large sized cages however reported flat revenue growth with management guiding for a strong H2 ramp-up as demand remains supportive across industrial and automotive applications.
